description: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct with v17 parametric logic-lock steering plus optional iterative anti-mode: hyper-purified S0 vectors, aggressive v17 schedule; when generating multiple samples per prompt, creative steering is orthogonalized against prior first-token L14 residuals to reduce semantic mode-collapse.

runtime_defaults.iterative_anti_mode_notes: benchmark_matchup.py applies per-sample L14 first-decode capture + purify_vector orthogonalization of creative .pt when --iterative-anti-mode is set; run_corpius_benchmark.py enables this by default.

promotion_rule: Iterative anti-mode promoted 2026-05-03 (gauntlet baseline_rb_1x30 vs gauntlet_C2_iter_rb_1x30, seed 501, same decode): mean Vendi +8.4% (1.976→2.142), mean NearDup −35.7% (0.129→0.083) on repeated-brief stress; robust 8x10 +1.4% Vendi and −6.7% NearDup. Prior JSON snapshot: legacy/config/corpius_1_pre_iterative_promotion_20260503.json. Earlier 2026-05-02 vector/schedule promotion unchanged.
known_caveats: Current implementation applies the method to Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct; future product intent is to apply the same representation-engineering method to larger models.
CreativityPrism is an LLM-judge signal and must be reported with judge model, rubric, sample mode, and missing-winner strata.
Diversity claims must come from robust prompt suites or repeated-brief stress tests, not smoke runs.

Aggressive decode hyperparameters (temperature, min_p, repetition_penalty) are chosen in the benchmark harness and LiveBench adapter separately from this JSON; align those for apples-to-apples citation runs.
Single-shot CLI generation (corpius CLI) does not apply iterative anti-mode; only multi-sample benchmark flows accumulate prior residuals per prompt.
